_note: Sites: somewhere to go that is not a port. No market, no fuel, no docking; you arrive on site and work. 'location' is as for places. 'visibility': known (on the map from the start), rumour (heard through tips), or hidden (only by story or contract). Each activity: needs (module abilities: survey, lander, mining), days of work, risk (chance it goes wrong: less yield, and for landings a fuel cost), yields (goods tonnes [min, max], into the hold as room allows), credits (paid on completion, e.g. survey data sold by radio), rep ({operator: amount}), and text for the result. 'once': worked out after one go.

ishikawa_maru.name: Derelict: Ishikawa Maru
ishikawa_maru.description: A Cooperative ice tanker that lost its drive controller in '58 and was left in a high lunar orbit, crew safe, cargo not. Salvage rights lapsed last year. Whoever gets there first.

salvage.name: Strip the wreck
salvage.text: Two days in suits with cutters and a cargo net. Her controller was fried, but the pumps are good.

hermes_probe.name: Dead probe: Hermes-7
hermes_probe.description: A deep-space relay that went silent in 2049 and has drifted ever since on a long, lazy orbit four times the Moon's distance out. The Compact would like its recorder back, and pays well for it.

salvage.name: Recover the recorder
salvage.text: The recorder comes out whole. Its last log is a long, odd dump of star-tracker data, which the Compact asks you not to share.

eros_survey.name: Eros
eros_survey.description: A 34 km near-Earth asteroid, stony and well mapped from orbit but never properly surveyed for what is under the regolith. The Belt Assembly buys good survey data.

survey.name: Survey from orbit
survey.text: Six days of radar passes and spectrometry. The data goes out by radio as you finish.

prospect.name: Land and core
prospect.text: The lander goes down on the saddle, drills three cores and comes back up dusty.

psyche_deep_claim.name: Psyche, the eastern claim
psyche_deep_claim.description: An unclaimed patch on Psyche's far side where the old Psyche mission's magnetometer saw something odd. The claimants say it is nothing. They have not been to look.

mine.name: Set up the rig and mine
mine.text: Ten days of drilling. The magnetometer was right: a pocket of platinum-group metal ten metres down.

phobos_survey.name: Phobos
phobos_survey.description: Mars' inner moon, 22 km of rubble spiralling slowly in. The Accord wants to know whether it is worth mining before it falls.

survey.name: Survey from orbit
survey.text: Four days of passes over the grooves. The data goes to the Accord as you finish.

prospect.name: Land at Stickney
prospect.text: Down into Stickney crater, where the shadowed walls hold ice.

hektor_survey.name: Hektor
hektor_survey.description: The largest of Jupiter's Trojans: two lobes, 225 km end to end, and almost unknown. Whoever surveys it first sets the claims map for the whole neighbourhood.

survey.name: Survey both lobes
survey.text: Ten days mapping the neck between the lobes. The Commons buys the map at once; the Belt Assembly pays to see it.
